messages:
Asha: Quick heads-up — editorial cram for release notes today. Need internal announce by 11:30 PT. Scope: model pin (serving tweaks + batching), short TL;DR, and quiet window. Who can do what?

Kai: I can own the pin check and deploybot cues. Plan: pin redwood-model-v2.4.0 in staging, run a short canary, then promote.

Matt: I'll do a scribe pass on copy and the TL;DR bullets. Can take localization-aware phrasing.

Olivia: I can do localization tags and quick FR/DE check. ETA 11:00 PT for comments.

Riley: Oncall available for the quiet window 12:00–13:00 PT. I'll be ready to trigger rollback lane if we hit thresholds.

Asha: Thanks. Pin handshake: Kai runs the staging pin, posts job URL. After canary OK, promote. Fallback: immediate pin to v2.3.9 if we see regressions.

Kai: Executing staging pin now — command: 
```
/deploy pin redwood-model-v2.4.0 --staging
```

deploybot: Received command: `/deploy pin redwood-model-v2.4.0 --staging` (requested by Kai). Job queued as job/12345.

Kai: Running quick smoke test: 
```bash
curl -s -XPOST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-model-v2.4.0","prompt":"test"}' | jq .status
```

Matt: Draft copy for internal announce (short):
"Release: v2.4.0 — serving + batching optimizations. Pinned for predictability (fallback v2.3.9). Quiet window 12:00–13:00 PT. Ops watching; no client action needed."

Olivia: Small localization note: mark "quiet window" as a product term and include UTC equivalents. Also prefer "more predictable throughput" over "predictability" in one line.

Riley: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) 5xx rate >2% sustained over 10m OR 2) >=20% latency regression P50 over 10m. If met: pin older model to prod, scale down canary, open incident bridge.

Asha: Agree on thresholds. Kai, please post the deploybot job URL when ready and ping Riley. Matt will wait for Riley :thumbsup: before posting internal announce.

Kai: staging pin job started — https://staging.deploy.redwood.ai/jobs/12345. Canary traffic at 5% now.

deploybot: Job 12345 update: canary healthy, 0 errors in last 5m.

Riley: Watching metrics dashboard. No anomalies at 10m check. ETA 20m for stable signal.

Matt: Will post the internal draft in this channel once Riley gives :thumbsup:. Draft will include: short TL;DR, rollback lanes, quiet window times, link to changelog, bullet for CS snippet.

Olivia: Also adding i18n TODOs and translation owners inline.

Kai: Canary stable at 25m. No regressions. Promoting command queued: 
```
/deploy promote redwood-model-v2.4.0 --prod
```

deploybot: Promotion scheduled for job/12346. ETA ~5m.

Riley: :thumbsup: from ops. Proceed. I'll keep the bridge open until quiet window closes.

Matt: Posting internal announce now (threaded). Pinning it for 24h and tagging CS + Docs.

Matt: (internal announce posted) — please review pinned message. Link to changelog and Confluence RN included.

Kai: Promotion finished successfully. prod traffic switched to v2.4.0. Job 12346 completed.

deploybot: Job 12346 finished — no errors reported.

Riley: Monitoring for next 30m. If 5xx spikes or latency regressions per the thresholds, I'll initiate rollback checklist.

Asha: Great work — small follow-ups: (1) update public changelog entry, (2) send CS snippet (Matt), (3) attach canary perf graphs to RN (Kai). If anything, reopen this thread. :rocket:
